label: Fires at D1 after a common a2->S2 loss, strongest when S2 was believed good and the trial before paid.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1)
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (tv("action", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * ep_dec ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * belief_cover ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * np.abs(belief_lo)
explanation: Sparse feature (nonzero on ~0.9% of steps), only at D1 and only in mid/late episode (timing baseline). Magnitude is driven by the previous trial being a2 -> S2 (common) unrewarded: a surprising loss in the state the observer believes is good. It is larger when belief_lo is more negative (S2 believed good) and when the trial before that was rewarded (first loss after a win). Zero at GO/D2 and after any other previous-trial pattern. Future/hidden variables add nothing (reference scores ~0). Free fit adds the choice two trials back, episode decile, belief cover and |belief_lo| as modulators within a2 S2 u (dev 0.33 vs 0.26). Much of the remaining error is on the first trial of each window, where the previous trial pattern is not available to last_is, and on within-pattern magnitude variance not captured by observed history.
